title: qgate RunResult
description: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 for the frozen RunResult contract (docs/01-architecture.md §5.2, runResultSchemaVersion=1.0). additionalProperties is false on the result, gate, blocker, check and evidence objects, so this schema enforces the REQ-QUALITY-GATE-004 key-set assertion directly: a RunResult with a missing baseline field or an extra field is invalid.

run_id.description: Run identity of the form `<ISO-ms timestamp>-<8 hex chars>`.

overall_passed.description: Equals gates.filter(g => g.required).every(g => g.passed), evaluated over the gates that RAN (see the gates property). If every gate is optional the value is true. A failed required check blocks regardless of its severity; severity only grades and escalates.

gates.description: Ordered by the five frozen stages (requirements, design, build, review, verify). Only gates that actually RAN appear here: with --stage/--gate the not-run gates are OMITTED (never carried as passed:false or passed:true), and are listed only in the --summary envelope as not_run_gates. The top-level overall_passed formula therefore evaluates every() over the required gates that ran (see docs/01-architecture.md SS5.2.1).

evidence.description: Evidence reference (§5.3.1). Every judgement must carry at least one.

excerpt.description: sha256:<hex> or a line fragment for kind=file; a JSON Pointer for kind=json_pointer.

severity.description: blocker/high block phase advancement; medium is technical debt; low is recorded only.

degraded.description: true when a requested provider fell back to deterministic offline behaviour.

humanGateResult.description: Present as an object when the gate declares a humanGate, and exactly null when it does not (§5.2).

approvedBy.description: Signer name, or null when unsigned. Expressed as oneOf with an explicit null branch (never as a nullable type union) so that any future string keyword such as minLength or pattern actually applies.

approvedAt.description: RFC3339 UTC signing time, or null when unsigned. Expressed as oneOf with an explicit null branch (never as a nullable type union) so that any future string keyword such as minLength or pattern actually applies.

checkId.description: The check that blocked; the gate id when a human gate blocks.

message.description: Machine-readable prefix plus explanation; prefixes are frozen in §9.2.

passed.description: The real judgement, unaffected by onFail=warn.

Frozen semantics (t27): true if and only if the gate contains NO check with required===true && passed===false && onFail!=="warn", and its human gate is satisfied. severity is NOT a blocking switch - it only grades, orders and escalates findings; the sole explicit non-blocking channel is onFail="warn".
